ModMetaData.name: Vandal Hearts Legacy Arrivals
ModMetaData.author: ellerain
ModMetaData.description:
Storyteller events that bring your Legacy characters (the chase roster from Vandal Hearts Chase Characters) to you:
- Legacy pod crash: a Legacy character crash-lands nearby, downed and factionless. Rescue them and hope they join, or capture them. - Legacy returns: a Legacy character walks up and asks to join. - Legacy on the run: a threat-reward quest where a Legacy character is chased by raiders and joins if you accept and fight them off. - Legacy prisoner rescue: a Legacy character is held at an enemy camp; break them out and they join. - Legacy distress call: a wounded Legacy character calls for help from a site on the world map; reach them and they join. - Legacy in hiding: shelter a hunted Legacy character for a few days through raids, and they stay for good. - Legacy fights beside you: a Legacy character arrives to help against a raid, and joins once it's beaten.
Events only fire while at least one Legacy character is out in the world.
